about_the_game:
Bring your anime imagination to life, no drawing skills required!

Anime Art Generator is a powerful AI Image Generator, fully offline tool that turns your text prompts into stunning anime-style illustrations in seconds.

Whether you're crafting your next project, a profile picture, designing original characters, or just having fun with creativity, this tool puts the magic of AI anime art right at your fingertips. 


NVIDIA Graphics Card is required 8GB VRAM Minimum, 12/16GB Recommended.

✨ Features:

🖌️ Easy Text-to-Anime Generation: Just type a description and watch as the app transforms it into beautiful anime art, no configuration is needed.

💻 100% Offline, No internet No problem: Everything runs locally on your device — no downloads, no accounts, no data sent anywhere.

🎨 Fast & High-Quality Outputs: Powered by an advanced anime-focused AI Agent, capable of generating detailed, vibrant, high-resolution images.

🧠 Smart Prompt Templates: Built-in prompt helpers and negative tag filters for optimal results with minimal effort.
💾 Safe and Private: Everything stays on your computer. No cloud processing, no hidden uploads — your creativity belongs to you.

⚙️ Multiple resolutions: Full HD, HD, Square, 2K, Mobile Wallpaper, create your art as you imagine it.

🐱 Cute, Clean UI: Simple, cozy interface designed with anime fans in mind. Whether you're an aspiring VTuber, a character designer, or just love generating anime girls (and boys!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (Minimum 8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 33 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVIDIA GPU is required, AMD Graphics is not supported currently
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (12GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 33 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVIDIA GPU is required, AMD Graphics is not supported currently

short_description: Describe your anime character or scene, get high‑resolution anime AI artwork, fast and 100% offline. Anime Art Generator runs locally with no accounts or configuration needed, giving artists, gamers, VN devs, and creators fast, private, gorgeous anime artworks.
